title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 105
paragraphs: In this battle, of the Greeks, the Athenians were the best men, and of the Athenians, Hermolycos son of Euthoinos, a man who had trained for the pancration. This Hermolycos, after these events, when there was war between the Athenians and the Carystians, was killed in battle at Kyrnos in the Carystian land near Geraistos, and was buried there. After the Athenians, the Corinthians, Troizenians, and Sikyonians were the best.
